flipToBack.prose: Flip if your slavers control two Kashyyyk battlegrounds (each controlled with a slaver there) and opponent controls no Kashyyyk locations.

children.req: control-with (count 2): you control 2 Kashyyyk battleground locations, each with a slaver
children.gameConditions: GameConditions.controlsWith(game, self, playerId, 2, Filters.and(Filters.Kashyyyk_location, Filters.battleground), SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.slaver)

children.req: control (opponent): opponent controls any Kashyyyk location

flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if opponent controls two Kashyyyk battlegrounds.

children.req: control (opponent, count 2): opponent controls 2 Kashyyyk battleground locations

requirementSemantics: Front flip uses CONTROL-WITH: 2 Kashyyyk battleground LOCATIONS (system counts, not just sites) each controlled by you with a slaver there; slaver is a keyword granted dynamically (your Trandoshans are slavers via KeywordModifier).
Opponent negative constraint: CONTROL zero Kashyyyk locations (any, battleground or not).
Flip-back: opponent CONTROLS 2 Kashyyyk battlegrounds; note asymmetry - opponent needs battlegrounds to flip you back, while any controlled Kashyyyk location blocks your forward flip.
No hard-lose/out-of-play condition on either side.
typedIdentities: Filters.slaver (Keyword.SLAVER); Filters.species(Species.TRANDOSHAN) granted Keyword.SLAVER by both sides
Filters.Scum_And_Villainy (may deploy on Slaving Camp HQ; uncancelable while you occupy it - OccupiesCondition)
Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.non_unique, Filters.slaver) immune to Title.Grimtaash while CardsInHandFewerThanCondition(owner, 13)
Back retrieval-to-hand classes: Filters.or(Filters.slaver, Filters.starship, Filters.vehicle)
setupAndPullRoutes: Setup (required on objective deploy): deploy Kashyyyk system (Filters.Kashyyyk_system), Slaving Camp Headquarters (Filters.title(Title.Slaving_Camp_Headquarters)), and [Block 8] Special Delivery (Filters.and(Icon.LEGACY_BLOCK_8, Filters.Special_Delivery)) from Reserve Deck (Card601_029.java:52-76).
No repeatable downloads/pulls on either side; back economy is destiny manipulation and retrieval-to-hand (below).
otherObligations: Both sides: your Trandoshans are slavers (Card601_029.java:84; Card601_029_BACK.java:62); Scum And Villainy may deploy on Slaving Camp HQ and may not be canceled while you OCCUPY that site (front :86-88; back :64-66); your non-unique slavers immune to Grimtaash while you have <13 cards in hand (front :90-91; back :68-69).
Back: whenever you 'enslave' a character (TriggerConditions.characterEnslavedBy), opponent must use 2 Force or lose 1 Force (forced lose 1 if they cannot use 2) (Card601_029_BACK.java:98-126).

Back: once per turn during battle, add or subtract up to X from your just-drawn destiny, X = Kashyyyk locations you control with a slaver (Filters.controlsWith(playerId, self, Filters.slaver)) (Card601_029_BACK.java:136-178).
Back: once per turn, if you just retrieved Force during battle and the retrieved card is a slaver/starship/vehicle, may take it into hand (Card601_029_BACK.java:180-195).
Strategic: hold 2 slaver-manned Kashyyyk battlegrounds and evict opponent from all Kashyyyk locations to flip; after flip, never let opponent control 2 Kashyyyk battlegrounds.

profileGaps: no profile exists in src/gemp-swccg-server/src/main/resources/objective_playbooks.json for frontBp 601_29 (Wookiee Slaving Operation); the full flip law (control-with 2 Kashyyyk battlegrounds via slavers + opponent controls 0 Kashyyyk locations), the flip-back exposure (opponent controls 2 Kashyyyk battlegrounds), the slaver keyword grant, and the setup pulls (Kashyyyk system, Slaving Camp Headquarters, [Block 8] Special Delivery) are entirely unencoded
